_comment: Sokoban v0.2 movement scenarios. Validates: walk into empty cell, walls block, box pushes when cell beyond is empty, push blocked when cell beyond is wall. Cell size = 32px. Level 1 layout: P(1,2)=(48,80), B(2,2)=(80,80), G(3,2)=(112,80), perimeter walls. Each test starts with fresh load via scenario_runner.

scenarios.name: walk_north_into_empty
scenarios._: Player at (48, 80) presses N. Target (48, 48) is empty cell (1,1). Should move.

scenarios.name: walk_south_into_empty
scenarios._: Player at (48, 80) presses S. Target (48, 112) is empty cell (1,3). Should move.

scenarios.name: wall_blocks_west
scenarios._: Player at (48, 80) presses W. Target (16, 80) is the west perimeter wall. Player must NOT move.

scenarios.name: push_box_onto_goal
scenarios._: Player(48,80) presses E. Target (80,80)=box. Cell beyond (112,80)=goal (empty for push). Box moves to 112,80. Player moves to 80,80.

scenarios.name: moves_increment_per_action
scenarios._: Each successful move increments level_clock.moves. Walk N then S — should be 2 moves (back to start).

scenarios.name: blocked_move_does_NOT_increment
scenarios._: Walking into a wall should not count as a move.

scenarios.name: push_box_onto_goal_wins
scenarios._: Pushing the box onto the goal should fire transition_level. Past the last level → world.all_levels_complete=1.

scenarios.name: restart_resets_level
scenarios._: Move N (player(48,80)→(48,48)), then press R: player respawns at level-start (48, 80). Verifies transition_level with current_level reloads.
